# Necessary Libraries

```{r}
library('tidyverse')
```

# Download the data

```{r}
height_data_clean <- read_csv("https://bis180ldata.s3.amazonaws.com/downloads/height_data_clean.csv")
# View(height_data_clean) # just checking my data frame
```

# Jan 27 Data

```{r}
height_data_clean_Jan27 <- height_data_clean %>% 
  filter(survey_date == '2023-01-27')
# View(height_data_clean_Jan27) # just checking my data frame
```

# Height Summary

```{r}
height_avg_Jan27 <- height_data_clean_Jan27 %>% 
  group_by(pop) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(
    avg_height = mean(height_cm, na.rm = T)
  )
print(height_avg_Jan27, n = nrow(height_avg_Jan27))
```
